headline: AMBER: HRV down 23 overnight. Today cut to 35min easy, Mon cut to 2 climbs
summary: HRV is 55 (yesterday 78), so it dropped 23 overnight. The amber trigger is a drop of more than 10, and amber overrides green. RHR 50 and 8.0h sleep (score 76) are fine, so this is a reaction to Saturday's load, not illness. Saturday's Presolana long run: 18.7km, 152min, 1006m D+, load 151 vs 170 planned (89%), average HR 149, max 176, RPE 7, but feel 5 (Weak). D+ and duration were on plan. CTL is 56.2, already above the 55 start-line target, ATL 66.8, TSB -10.6. Six days before the race, freshness wins. Today is 35min easy instead of 50. Monday's race-specific session drops from 3 climbs to 2. Sofia days and the taper stay as they are.
flags: Feel 5 (Weak) after Sat 31 even though load was under plan (151/170): the legs took more than the numbers show. Walk the steep descents today.
CTL 56.2 is already above the 55 target. The rest of race week buys freshness, not fitness. No extra reps Monday even if it feels good.
suggestedChange: Sun 1 cut 50 to 35min easy (load 45 to 30); Mon 2 cut 3x10 to 2x10min climbs (load 85 to 65).
